title: Card Kit Fulfilment Rules — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
Kits for the Paystride Payroll Card Program are ordered only while the program status is contracted or live.

**Order size and destination.** A kit order is at least the package's smallest kit order, in multiples of the package's order multiple, ships to one of at most the package's number of employer locations, and is refused when the unissued kits held at the employer's locations together with the order would exceed the package's ceiling on unissued kits.

**Shipping times.** Standard orders ship within the package's standard processing business days and expedited orders arrive within the package's expedited delivery business days.

**Kit inventory.** The count of unissued kits held rises by the kits delivered and falls by one for each card issued from a kit at the employer's location.

**Fees.** Kit and shipping fees follow the program fee billing rules.

### Status test

| Program status | Kits may be ordered |
|---|---|
| contracted | yes |
| live | yes |
| suspended | no |
| terminated | no |

The status is read from the program record of the employer's own program.

### Order checks (hypothetical, Standard package: smallest order 25, multiple 25, ceiling 150, up to 2 locations)

| Unissued kits held | Kits ordered | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 40 | 100 | accepted size; 140 held counting the order, within 150 |
| 40 | 125 | refused; 165 counting the order exceeds 150 |
| 0 | 30 | not a multiple of 25 |
